title: skills: the six metadata skills trigger on what the user is doing, not on TypeScript file names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Part of #34769
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:通过 MCP 搭应用、手里没有项目文件的人,向助手提「加个对象」「做个看板」「到期自动提醒」这类需求时,对应的六个建模技能更容易被助手加载;以前这些技能主要靠文件名触发。
- 为什么做:属于「MCP 二期与问数」这条线,让不写代码的搭建者也能用上技能包。
- 出错会怎样:新描述若把相邻任务误吸进来,助手会多加载一个不相干的技能,多花一点上下文;撤回本次改动即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:无(这张卡的「前后触发率对比」还欠着,要等评测工具支持「只跑触发用例」之后补测,所以本次合并不关卡)。

## What changes

Frontmatter `description:` of the six metadata skills only; no skill body line changes. Each description now

- leads with the task in the user's words, "in a project or through MCP" (`objectstack-query` names MCP in its use-when clause instead: a query is not authored metadata);
- keeps file names (`*.object.ts`, `*.flow.ts`, `*.view.ts`, `*.translation.ts`) as a secondary cue inside the "Use when" sentence;
- ends with a "Not for" clause that names the neighbouring bundle. Every name is a directory under `skills/`: `objectstack-data`, `-query`, `-automation`, `-platform`, `-ui`, `-api`, `objectui`.

| Skill | Chars before | Chars after | Leads with | Not for |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| `objectstack-data` | 689 | 448 | Design or change an ObjectStack data model, in a project or through MCP | querying records (objectstack-query), flows or approvals (objectstack-automation), or plugin hooks (objectstack-platform). |
| `objectstack-ui` | 849 | 447 | Build what users see in an ObjectStack app, in a project or through MCP | objects and fields (objectstack-data), screen flows that branch between steps (objectstack-automation), or `@object-ui/*` React code (objectui). |
| `objectstack-automation` | 575 | 432 | Automate an ObjectStack app, in a project or through MCP | validation rules or record hooks on an object (objectstack-data), or kernel / plugin events (objectstack-platform). |
| `objectstack-formula` | 570 | 450 | Write a CEL expression wherever ObjectStack takes one, in a project or through MCP | ObjectQL query filters (objectstack-query), SQL fragments, or hook bodies (objectstack-data). |
| `objectstack-i18n` | 527 | 439 | Translate an ObjectStack app, in a project or through MCP | i18n libraries outside ObjectStack bundles, or `@object-ui/*` component strings (objectui). |
| `objectstack-query` | 432 | 435 | Write an ObjectQL query over ObjectStack records | adding objects or fields (objectstack-data), a list view's filter or a dashboard dataset (objectstack-ui), or designing an API endpoint (objectstack-api). |

Character counts are the YAML-parsed folded scalar, trimmed (code points).

<details><summary>The six descriptions in full</summary>

**objectstack-data** (448)

> Design or change an ObjectStack data model, in a project or through MCP: objects, fields, relationships, validation rules, indexes, record hooks, permissions, seed / demo data, external datasources, and field `visibleWhen` / `requiredWhen` rules. Use when modelling records or editing `*.object.ts` / `src/data/*.ts`. Not for querying records (objectstack-query), flows or approvals (objectstack-automation), or plugin hooks (objectstack-platform).

**objectstack-ui** (447)

> Build what users see in an ObjectStack app, in a project or through MCP: list / form / kanban / calendar views, navigation, pages, dashboards, reports, charts, action buttons and package docs. Use when changing a screen, menu, chart or button, or editing `*.view.ts` / `*.page.ts` / `*.app.ts`. Not for objects and fields (objectstack-data), screen flows that branch between steps (objectstack-automation), or `@object-ui/*` React code (objectui).

**objectstack-automation** (432)

> Automate an ObjectStack app, in a project or through MCP: act when a record is created or changes, on a schedule or from a webhook; approvals, notifications, assignment rules, and screen flows / wizards that branch between steps. Use when the request is "when X happens, do Y" or you are editing `*.flow.ts`. Not for validation rules or record hooks on an object (objectstack-data), or kernel / plugin events (objectstack-platform).

**objectstack-formula** (450)

> Write a CEL expression wherever ObjectStack takes one, in a project or through MCP: formula fields, `visibleWhen` / `requiredWhen` rules, validation, sharing and visibility predicates, flow conditions, seed values, Salesforce formulas ported to CEL. Use when asked how to express a condition or calculation, or writing an `F`, `P` or `cel` literal. Not for ObjectQL query filters (objectstack-query), SQL fragments, or hook bodies (objectstack-data).

**objectstack-i18n** (439)

> Translate an ObjectStack app, in a project or through MCP: object and field labels, select options, view, navigation and dashboard text, automation messages; add a locale, and find and fill missing keys (`os i18n check`). Use when adding a language, relabelling for a locale, or editing `*.translation.ts` or a `translation` metadata item. Not for i18n libraries outside ObjectStack bundles, or `@object-ui/*` component strings (objectui).

**objectstack-query** (435)

> Write an ObjectQL query over ObjectStack records: filter, sort, paginate, aggregate by group, expand related records, full-text search. Use when writing a query in app code or a hook, choosing a pagination strategy, or shaping a records query or aggregation sent over MCP. Not for adding objects or fields (objectstack-data), a list view's filter or a dashboard dataset (objectstack-ui), or designing an API endpoint (objectstack-api).

</details>

Two generated mirrors move with the frontmatter, by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-docs`: the index table in `skills/README.md` and the cards in `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`. They are outside the claimed file surface and are in this PR because `check:skill-docs` reds without them (measured: exit 1 before the regeneration, exit 0 after).

Net added lines, whole PR, changeset included: **68 added, 89 deleted, net -21** (`git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD` at `5bfdd7f51c`, unchanged at `0b30f98b31`; budget 30).

Token ratchet (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0): no ceiling row is edited. Standing ruling 6513306068 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 is met by its first half alone: the restated trigger lists were cut and nothing is left to raise.

Whole shipped bundle: 280730 tokens before, 280469 after. Whole files in lines, before to after: data 476 to 472, ui 168 to 161, automation 478 to 476, formula 493 to 491, i18n 523 to 521, query 439 to 439. All `SKILL.md` in the catalog together: 4861 lines before, 4844 after.

Read first: `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` (the one description that names MCP for a non-authoring task; risk hunk is its "sent over MCP" clause next to `objectstack-ask`), then `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` and `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (the wizard / screen-flow boundary sits in both "Not for" and lead).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs && node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `Skill docs in sync` and `59 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`.

## Evals

No model round was run, by order. Read against each bundle's `evals/triggers.json` (5 positives, 2 negatives each):

- every positive is named by the lead or the use-when clause (for example data 4 "demo data", data 5 a conditional field rule, automation 2 "on a schedule", automation 4 "wizards that branch between steps", formula 2 "Salesforce formulas ported to CEL", i18n 4 `os i18n check`, query 3 "aggregation sent over MCP");
- every in-product negative is named by a "Not for" clause that points at the owning bundle (data 6 to `objectstack-query`, ui 6 to `objectstack-automation`, automation 6 to `objectstack-data`, formula 6 to `objectstack-query`, query 6 to `objectstack-data`, query 7 to `objectstack-ui`);
- the out-of-product negatives (plain PostgreSQL, plain React, GitHub Actions, Excel, react-i18next, `Intl.NumberFormat`) meet a description whose every clause says ObjectStack; the formula text deliberately does not say "Excel".

## Verification

Gates below ran at head `5bfdd7f51c`. The current head `0b30f98b31` adds one commit that changes one line of the changeset ("432 to 450" characters, the measured lengths); no description, mirror or ratchet row moved, and CI is green on it (33 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed). The diff touches no package source, so there is no dependency-closure build.

- The six frontmatter blocks parse with a YAML parser to a single-line scalar ending in the "Not for" clause.

## Acceptance notes

- **Done-when measurement is owed, after #35705** (the trigger-cases-only runner flag). Before = `--skills-from` the `@objectstack/skills` version current at merge; after = the workspace; same weakest tracked model; trigger cases only. Until that reading exists the card stays open, which is why this PR says "Part of".
- The docs generator splits a description at "Use when" and "Do not use". A "Not for" ending is not a split point, so in the Skills reference each of these six cards shows the use-when and the not-for clause as one paragraph (as `objectstack-project` already does). Text is verbatim; only the paragraph break is gone. Not changed here: the generator is outside this card.
- `objectstack-query` trigger case 3 (a business question asked over MCP, expected to load the query skill) sits inside what `objectstack-ask` claims as its own ("every question answered from the app's records"). The new query text keeps that positive plausible ("a records query or aggregation sent over MCP") and so does not name `objectstack-ask` in its "Not for". Which of the two owns that request is for the eval seat to read off the measurement.
- Dropped from the descriptions, still taught in the bodies: the "load objectstack-formula alongside" pointer (data, ui, automation), the ADR numbers and source tiers of pages, the `defineJob` / `defineWebhook` spellings, `readonlyWhen` in the data list, and the stepped-form-over-one-object note in ui.
- `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx` and the prose example in `skills/README.md` quote an older `objectstack-data` description as an illustration of the frontmatter shape; they are hand-written and were already different from the live text. Left as they are.
